Type: woven rocking lounge chair
Use: lounging, rocking; living room, sunroom, kids' corner
Style: bohemian, coastal, rustic
Materials: hand-woven natural plant fiber over a frame
Colors: natural greige, warm sand, light brown
Shape: low sloping seat on a curved rocking base, tall narrow back ending in a looped handle, solid woven sides, sculptural, low and compact
Feel: organic, quirky, relaxed, natural
